transcript.text: Last spring I was in Chongqing for a work thing, and we ended up talking way too much about where to eat there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later on, I also spent a weekend in Suzhou and kept hearing people rave about the local shows and theater scene.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Chongqing trip, our group meal was at Liuyishou Hotpot, and it was honestly chaos in the best way.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember it clearly because it was on 2025-03-06, and they set us for 14:00 even though it felt like an oddly late lunch.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: There were 9 of us, and my coworker Feng Jie was the contact person on it — her phone was 13898776655.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Suzhou, my friend Sun Lei had already gotten a single ticket for Kunqu Opera Peony Pavilion, First Floor seats, and the number he used was 13830018365.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Negative intent throughout: user is reminiscing about past trips and already-completed arrangements; no request for help or action.
